♠️ PokerHand

Cards are dealt and you must arrange them into the best possible poker hand. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Five cards are dealt — choose which to keep and which to discard.
  2. Click to select cards to hold, then draw to replace discards.
  3. Your final hand is ranked against the poker hand rankings.
  4. Know the hand rankings: High Card < Pair < Two Pair < Three of a Kind < Straight < Flush < Full House < Four of a Kind < Straight Flush.
  5. Strategic discard: keep cards that contribute to a potential strong hand.
